name: @amykit/plugin-claude
description: The claude CLI as the agent, over its JSON envelope.
author: Nicolas Melo

amy.about: Use it when the agent should be Claude Code, run through the claude CLI. It contributes a harness and a usage reader to agent-relay instead of mounting the agent port itself, so install agent-relay with it, and list codex or hermes-agent too when the relay should have somewhere to fall back. Claude reports what each run cost, so a ceiling in money works without a row in the price table.
